title: Make numbers easier to work with
description: Build three reusable mental-maths tools: adjust a number, split a multiplication and combine familiar percentages.
introduction: Begin by changing a calculation without changing its answer. Then use that idea to split multiplication into parts, before combining parts of a whole.
prerequisites: Comfort with basic addition, subtraction and multiplication.
outcomes: Explain the correction after rounding a number.
Multiply by 11 and handle a carry.
Build percentages from tenths, halves and quarters.

lessons.objective: Use nearby tens, then undo exactly what you changed.
Split multiplication into ten copies and one more; handle carrying.
Combine familiar shares to find a percentage of a whole.

glossary.definition: Adjusting a calculation, then correcting for that change.
Multiplying a sum by multiplying its parts and adding the results.
